updateRule: id = @request.auth.id && @request.body.plan:isset = false && @request.body.planStatus:isset = false && @request.body.stripeCustomerId:isset = false && @request.body.stripeSubscriptionId:isset = false && @request.body.expiresAt:isset = false
name: users

emailTemplate.subject: Login from a new location
emailTemplate.body:
New sign-in to {APP_NAME}
We noticed a login from a new location:
{ALERT_INFO}
If this was not you, reset your password in Tudso to sign out other devices.
If this was you, you can ignore this email.

emailTemplate.subject: OTP for {APP_NAME}
emailTemplate.body:
Your one-time code
Use this code to continue in {APP_NAME}.
{OTP}
If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email.

verificationTemplate.subject: Verify your {APP_NAME} email
verificationTemplate.body:
Verify your email
Confirm this address to finish setting up {APP_NAME}.
Verify email
If the button does not work, open this link:
https://tudso.com/auth/verify-email?token={TOKEN}
If you did not create a {APP_NAME} account, you can ignore this email.

resetPasswordTemplate.subject: Reset your {APP_NAME} password
resetPasswordTemplate.body:
Reset your password
Choose a new password for your {APP_NAME} account. This link expires in 30 minutes.
Reset password
If the button does not work, open this link:
https://tudso.com/auth/reset-password?token={TOKEN}
If you did not ask to reset your password, you can ignore this email.

confirmEmailChangeTemplate.subject: Confirm your {APP_NAME} new email address
confirmEmailChangeTemplate.body:
Confirm your new email
Someone asked to change the email on a {APP_NAME} account. Confirm it here, then enter your current password.
Confirm new email
If the button does not work, open this link:
https://tudso.com/auth/confirm-email-change?token={TOKEN}
If you did not ask to change your email, you can ignore this message.
